diagnosis: read-heavy-analysis-development-a: Trace invoice retry duplication across worker, ledger, and idempotency layers

failureChain.statement: The gateway capture occurs before acknowledgement and no stable idempotency key is passed; redelivery can charge twice.
The available idempotency key changes with attempt, so it cannot deduplicate retries for the same invoice.

excludedHypotheses: tests/test_currency.py is unrelated; integer minor units do not address retry identity.
